item.title: Spring College in the Physics of Complex Systems — ICTP and SISSA
item.description: Dates: 15 Feb – 12 Mar 2027 · 26 days. Location: ICTP Kastler Lecture Hall (AGH) Adriatico Guest House - Kastler Lecture Hall Riva Massimiliano e Carlotta, Grignano I - 34151 Trieste (Italy). Deadline: 2026-11-01. Fee EUR 0 · A limited number of grants are available to support the attendance of selected participants, with priority given to participants from developing countries.. Topics: physics, statistical physics, engineering, neuroscience

item.title: International Winter School on Additive Manufacturing — From Theory to Practice — IAM at Politecnico di Torino
item.description: Dates: 18 Jan – 29 Jan 2027 · 12 days. Location: Turin, Italy. Deadline: 2026-11-15. The €150 fee includes lectures, laboratories, teaching materials, listed lunches and technical visit · Apply on official page. Topics: engineering, design

item.title: VIASM-IAMP Summer School 2027 on Probability and Mathematical Physics — International Research Laboratory France-Vietnam in Mathematics and its Applications, University of Tours; Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM)
item.description: Dates: 23 Jul – 28 Jul 2027 · 6 days. Location: Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM), Hanoi. Deadline: 2027-07-01. Registration: free · Accommodation, meals and travel support: not stated. Topics: probability, mathematical physics, statistical physics, mathematics

item.title: IMISCOE PhD School 2027 — Regional Migration Studies: Dynamics of Human Mobility, Governance and Socioeconomic Transformations — GRITIM-UPF at Universitat Pompeu Fabra in collaboration with the EuroMedMig Marie Skłodowska-Curie PhD Project
item.description: Dates: 13 Sep – 17 Sep 2027 · 5 days. Location: Ciutadella Campus, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) in Barcelona, Spain. Deadline: 2026-11-15. IMISCOE member institutes: EUR 400 (EU/OECD), EUR 200 (non-EU/non-OECD); non-member institutes: EUR 600 (EU/OECD), EUR 300 (non-EU/non-OECD) · Competitive awards; not guaranteed. Two (2) full scholarships , covering the registration fee, plus travel and accommodation expenses up to a combined maximum of €800 per scholarship. Two (2) registration fee waivers , covering the registration fee only. · Apply on official page. Topics: geography
